title: Transition to Overhead View of Refracting Waves
full_prompt:
Write a complete ManimGL script that visualizes a wave propagating through space and entering a medium with a different refractive index, transitioning from a 3D perspective view to a flat overhead 2D view. 

Your implementation must include:
1. A custom `WaveIntoMedium` class inheriting from `TimeVaryingVectorField` (or implementing custom time-varying vector field logic) that calculates wave phase based on propagation direction, frequency, and a refractive index change across a defined interface boundary.
2. A `ScalarFieldByOpacity` class inheriting from `DotCloud` that maps points to opacity values dynamically using an updater function.
3. A `WavesByOpacity` class that links the vector field values to dot cloud opacities to visually represent wavefronts.
4. A medium representation using `VCube` (or a 3D block) that is rotated and positioned to align with the interface boundary.
5. A scene class `TransitionToOverheadView` that inherits from a base interactive/3D scene, sets up the wave and medium, and performs a camera transition from a 3D perspective angle to a direct overhead (0, 0) view while the wave continues to propagate and refract.

common_failure_modes.pattern: Missing ManimGL-specific classes like DotCloud or VCube in standard ManimCE environments
common_failure_modes.note: DotCloud and VCube are exclusive to ManimGL/manimlib. Standard Manim Community Edition (ManimCE) will fail to execute this code directly without custom implementations of these classes.

common_failure_modes.pattern: Incorrect phase calculation at the interface boundary
common_failure_modes.note: The phase calculation must correctly incorporate the refractive index step function to show realistic wave bending (refraction).
